grammar.summary: 本课学习 drop 表钻探的精准动词与 have difficulty doing。

points.title: have difficulty (in) doing
points.explanation: We have no difficulty in finding oil. have difficulty/trouble + (in) doing，介词可省。

examples.en: The geologist has to know where to drill.
examples.cn: 地质学家必须知道在哪里钻探。

points.title: 疑问词 + to do 复合结构
points.explanation: know where to drill / how to do it 疑问词+不定式作宾语，简洁高效。

examples.en: They have to decide how deep to go.
